blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Учитель, ___ (радовать / радоваться)! весело приветствовал он путника.
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Он ___ (встать / лечь / сесть) и, пряча лукавство, сказал:
exercises.why: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect; some have other changes: читать — прочитать, получать — получить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: Там, на ___ (горный) перевалах, лесные поляны покрыты сплошными коврами фиалок.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Дважды-Венчанный взглянул на мрачные, утонувшие в ___ (тень) горы.
exercises.why: «Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions В or НА. The same nouns have the regular ending -е after О, ОБ.» — DLI, Lesson 27. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions В or НА. The same nouns have the regular ending -е after О, ОБ.» — DLI, Lesson 27.

exercises.q: На ___ (скамья), охватив колено руками, подавшись лицом вперед, сидела и смотрела на толпу.
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Он увидел путника, ___ (выпрямиться / выпрямляться), откинул кудри с загорелого лица и радостно сверкнул зубами и белками глаз.
exercises.why: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect; some have other changes: читать — прочитать, получать — получить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: ___ (искать / поискать) ту высшую Красоту, которая где-нибудь да должна же быть.
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: ___ (нести / понести) нам лучшего вина, сыру, винограду!..
exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.

exercises.q: Искать ту высшую Красоту, которая где-нибудь да ___ (должный) же быть.
exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.q: Но нигде не находил он той, ___ (который) искал.
exercises.why: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI, Lesson 53. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative.

exercises.q: В глубине площади возвышались два огромных, одинаковой величины, ___ (прямоугольник), завещанных полотном.
exercises.why: «The genitive case is used to denote the possessor or owner … A noun in the genitive case is sometimes used to qualify (modify) another noun.» — DLI, Lesson 23. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «The genitive case is used to denote the possessor or owner … A noun in the genitive case is sometimes used to qualify (modify) another noun.» — DLI, Lesson 23.

exercises.q: Радостный, греющий свет лился от ___ (картина) и озарял все кругом.
exercises.why: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.

exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Взглянул — и вскочил на ___ (ноги) быстро, как юноша.
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Единорог с размаху всадил ___ (блестящий) секиру в обрубок и крикнул, ликуя:
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.why: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18.

exercises.q: С ___ (усилие), как бы свершая вынужденное кощунство, протянул он палочку ко второй картине.
exercises.why: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.
